description: This file defines a class `ClassStubber` that extends ASM's `ClassVisitor` to generate stub implementations for class methods while passing through other class components unchanged.

classes.name: ClassStubber
classes.description: A class visitor that creates stubs for methods in the visited class, extending ASM's `ClassVisitor`.

methods.name: ClassStubber
methods.description: Constructor that initializes `ClassStubber` with a delegate `ClassVisitor`.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Overrides `visit` to pass class details to the delegate visitor.

methods.name: visitEnd
methods.description: Overrides `visitEnd` to finalize the visitation process.

methods.name: visitMethod
methods.description: Overrides to create a `MethodStubber` for each method, generating method stubs.

methods.name: visitInnerClass
methods.description: Overrides to handle inner class declarations.

methods.name: visitOuterClass
methods.description: Overrides to handle outer class references.
